faq.q1: How do I place an order on MartBari?
faq.a1: Simply select your desired product, choose any variant, click 'Order Now' or 'Add to Cart', and enter your name, phone number, and address. No account registration is required.
faq.q2: How does Cash on Delivery (COD) work?
faq.a2: Our delivery partner will bring the parcel to your doorstep anywhere in Bangladesh. You inspect the parcel and pay the delivery agent in cash or via mobile wallet upon handover.
faq.q3: What are the delivery charges and how do I get Free Delivery?
faq.a3: Delivery is ৳70 inside Dhaka and ৳130 outside Dhaka. When your total order amount reaches ৳3,000 or more, delivery is 100% free nationwide!
faq.q4: What is your return and warranty policy?
faq.a4: If you receive a defective or damaged product, notify our team via phone or WhatsApp within 7 days of delivery. We will arrange a prompt replacement.
faq.q5: Are all gadgets original and covered by warranty?
faq.a5: Yes. Every product on MartBari is sourced from verified distributors and includes quality assurance plus applicable brand or store replacement warranty.
